sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan's live official tourism-board nationality table directly maps the Marshall Islands to a visa issued on arrival for 40 JOD.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Marshall Islands | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

policies.title: Marshallese ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Marshall Islands visitors can obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Marshall Islands passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.
